import hopsworks

def derive_feature_group():
    hopsworks.login()
    fs = hopsworks.feature_store()
    
    # Get the feature groups
    rawa_fg = fs.get_feature_group("rawa6913f1", version=1)
    rawb_fg = fs.get_feature_group("rawb6913f1", version=1)
    
    # Get the data
    rawa_df = rawa_fg.read()
    rawb_df = rawb_fg.read()
    
    # Perform INNER join on row_id
    merged_df = rawa_df.merge(rawb_df, on="row_id", how="inner")
    
    # Compute col_sum
    merged_df["col_sum"] = (merged_df["a_val"] + merged_df["b_val"]).round(6)
    
    # Select only the columns we need
    result_df = merged_df[["row_id", "col_sum"]]
    
    # Create the derived feature group
    derived_fg = fs.create_feature_group(
        name="derived6913f1",
        version=1,
        primary_key=["row_id"],
        online_enabled=True,
        description="Derived from rawa6913f1 and rawb6913f1"
    )
    
    # Insert the data
    derived_fg.insert(result_df)

if __name__ == "__main__":
    derive_feature_group()
EOF
